title: Two Sum
description:
Given a list of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the **indices** of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`.

You may assume that each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice. Return the indices as a tuple `(i, j)` where `i < j`.
hint: Use a dictionary to store numbers you've seen so far and look up the complement.
outputExplanation: For [2, 7, 11, 15] and target 9, we find 2 at index 0 and 7 at index 1, so the answer is (0, 1).
